tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the EveryAI directory for AI tools that fit a task, e.g. "transcribe podcast episodes" or "logo maker". Returns the best matches with their EveryAI page, website, category and a short description. Listings marked "featured" are paid placements.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full public details of one listed tool (description, features, category, links), found by its EveryAI page URL, its slug, its website, or its exact name.

tools.name: check_listing
tools.description: Whether a website already has a live EveryAI listing, and what its owner can do next (claim it, or list it if it is not there yet).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: EveryAI's categories with their use cases (subcategories), hub pages and how many tools each has.

tools.name: get_featured_offer
tools.description: What a Featured listing on EveryAI costs (one-time, no subscription), what it includes, and how a founder buys it. Pass the founder's country for their price.

tools.name: prepare_submission
tools.description: For a founder who wants their tool on EveryAI: returns a link to the submit form prefilled with the details you pass. Nothing is submitted; the founder opens it, signs in, and submits free or pays for Featured themselves. If the site is already listed, returns that listing and how to claim it instea

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tool · Public sink: prepare_submission.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tool · Public sink: prepare_submission

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
